correctness.rationale: A unique rotation moves the omitted output to zero and no nonidentity rotation fixes it. One doubled output, its pair of preimages, and a bijection on the other six inputs specify a normalized map, yielding 7·28·6!=141120. A word is exactly a directed path of pointwise images in the 255 nonempty subsets. Reverse unit-cost BFS from all singletons therefore returns each exact shortest merging length or marks it unreachable. An unreachable triple gives T₃=∞, and if all triples merge then all pairs do by extension; repeatedly merging a pair of current image states resets the full automaton. Independently enumerating every normalized map and all 56 triples, using direct inverse-fibre predecessors and inverse rotation rather than running submitted code, reproduced all 23 nonzero finite bins, 1856 unmergeable classes, 139264 synchronizing classes and all 205 joint histogram cells. The unique finite maximum is 37 at (1,1,2,3,4,5,6,7), with hardest triple {1,4,6} and word a^4(ba^7)^4b. Two maps attain 33 and one attains 31; all other finite values above 33 except 37 are absent. The two stated maps with reset length 28 have T₃=12 and T₃=24, also checked with forward shortest-word witnesses. Both marginal and joint assertions refer to the complete fixed-family census, not an all-order extrapolation.
residual_risks: Normalizing by arbitrary permutations or exchanging the two letters would be a different census. Unmergeable classes are not included in the finite joint histogram.

originality.rationale: The invariant, normalization of this family, unreachable count, and the individual Černý distance of 37 have antecedents. The new claim supported here is the complete worst-triple and joint distribution, including unique finite extremality over all rank-seven companions and the gap to the runner-up. The exact earlier census computes only the full-state reset quantity, which does not even determine T₃ on an individual map; the exact earlier subset formula applies to a single companion per n. No inspected stronger result already yields the stated census. The inaccessible Zhang supplement is a named limitation, not negative evidence.
residual_risks: The Zhang supplement was not inspected, and other unindexed tables could overlap. The assessment does not infer priority from catalogue dates, a keyword miss, or the correctness of the computation.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact comparison of prescribed-subset and full synchronization for the complete fixed-order circular defect-one family, already a meaningful full-reset benchmark. Worst prescribed triples measure a different hitting problem than the known reset thresholds, with a witnessed separation even at identical reset length. The complete distribution and isolated extremum give checkable boundaries for future work on extremal triple times, not just another run confirming the known distance for a single automaton.
residual_risks: No asymptotic result or general rank-seven extremal principle is inferred from the eight-state cutoff.
